function.name: chi_squared_test

So we pass table: [10,20,30,40].

We also can optionally specify alpha default 0.05.

Thus we call functions.chi_squared_test with table: [10,20,30,40].

We then output the result. The function will return something. We need to output the result. Probably the function returns an object with chi-square statistic, degrees of freedom, p-value, etc. We'll just output whatever it returns.
